meta.title: Ancestor birth charts & family history by hand | Ascendant
meta.description: A genealogist researches your family line by hand in the archives. You receive the findings, a family tree, a map and a birth chart for every ancestor. Free during the first version.

footer.tagline: Ascendant. Researched by a person, read under the sky they were born under.

tree.title: Family tree, drawn as a constellation
tree.hint: Select a person to open their card beside the tree.
tree.noChart: No chart yet: a full birth date (day, month and year) is needed.

landing.headline: Your ancestors were born under a sky, too.
landing.support: Tell us who you know: yourself, your parents, your grandparents. Teresa researches your line by hand in the archives, then publishes what she finds here, with a birth report for every ancestor.
landing.private: Private by default · English and Spanish
landing.step1Title: You tell us who you know
landing.step1Body: A short intake: names, dates and places for you, your parents and your grandparents. Leave blank what you do not know. That is what the research is for.
landing.step2Body: Teresa works through parish books, civil registers and censuses herself. There is no matching engine and nothing is searched automatically.
landing.step3Body: Her findings are published privately for you, with a small family tree and a birth report for each ancestor. Invite relatives to read along.
landing.honestTitle: No instant matches. No public trees.
landing.honest1: Ascendant will never tell you in thirty seconds that you descend from a king. Research takes the time it takes, and you will be told plainly what is documented and what is still open.
landing.honest2: Most of your ancestors’ birth hours were never written down. Their reports say so, and show what can honestly be known from the date alone: the planets by sign, without a guessed Ascendant.
landing.honest3: Your request and its findings are visible only to you, to Teresa, and to the people you invite to read.
landing.flourish: Genealogy by hand · charts by the sky
landing.demoPrompt: Just looking? Try it with sample data
landing.skyHint: The sky right now. Rest on a planet.

dashboard.title: My requests
dashboard.emptyBody: Start with what you know about yourself, your parents and your grandparents. It takes about ten minutes.

intake.title: Who do you know?
intake.introSelf: Start with yourself. Your birth hour and place let us draw your full chart, Ascendant included.
intake.introParents: Now your parents. Exact dates help, but a year is better than nothing.
intake.introGrandparents: Your four grandparents. Fill in what you know and leave the rest blank. Unknowns are the starting point of the research.
intake.focusLabel: What would you most like to find out? (optional)
intake.focusPlaceholder: A family story to confirm, a branch nobody talks about, where a surname came from…
intake.honest: Teresa researches every request by hand, so findings take time. Nothing is searched or matched automatically.
intake.needNames: To submit, add at least a name for yourself and for both parents.
intake.error_locked: This request has already been submitted.
intake.error_names: Add at least a name for yourself and for both parents.

person.dateHint: A year alone is fine. A chart needs the full date.
person.placeHint: Pick a town from the list to locate it, or type freely (a parish, a farmhouse).
person.placeLocated: Located. Coordinates and time zone saved for the chart.
person.notesPlaceholder: Trade, nicknames, family stories, anything useful…
person.saveError: This could not be saved. Check the details and try again.
person.editLead: A full birth date unlocks the birth report. The hour and a located birthplace add the Ascendant and houses.
person.newEyebrow: Add an ancestor found during research
person.residencesHint: One place per line. Add the years in brackets if you know them. They appear on the family map.

request.explain_draft: This request is still a draft.
request.explain_submitted: Your request has reached Teresa. She will begin the research soon, and the status here will change when she does.
request.explain_in_research: Teresa is working on your line in the archives. Findings will be published on this page; there is nothing you need to do.
request.treeLead: One generation per orbit, paternal line on the left. The outer band is the zodiac, with each person’s Sun marked where it stood at their birth.
request.reportsLead: One for each person with a full birth date. Without a birth hour a report shows the planets by sign only.
request.focus: What you asked us to look for
request.mapLead: Where each person was born, lived and died. Rest on a name to follow their path, or on a place to see who was there.

invites.lead: Create a private link for a relative. Anyone with the link can read the published findings and the birth reports of deceased ancestors. They cannot edit anything, and living people appear by relationship only.
invites.notYet: Links start working once the findings are published.

report.noChart_no_date: A birth report needs a full birth date: day, month and year. None is recorded for this person yet.
report.noChart_partial_date: Only part of the birth date is known so far. A report appears as soon as the day, month and year are confirmed.
report.noChart_out_of_range: Charts are available for births from 1600 onwards.
report.captionFull: Cast for the recorded hour and place
report.captionNoPlace: Cast for the recorded hour · no located place
report.captionNoon: Cast for noon · hour unknown · bar marks the Moon’s range that day
report.risingRole: Rising · how they met the world
report.risingNeedsHour: The Ascendant changes every two hours. Without a recorded birth hour it cannot be known, so none is shown.
report.risingNeedsPlace: Pick the birthplace from the list to locate it and the Ascendant will appear.
report.noonNotice: The birth hour is not recorded, so this chart is cast for noon. Signs are reliable for every planet that did not change sign that day; the Ascendant and houses are left out rather than guessed.
report.utcNotice: The birthplace is not located, so the hour was read as universal time. Locate the place for exact positions.
report.cuspNote: The sign changed that day. If the birth fell on the other side, read {sign} instead:
report.seeSun: Core character. See the reading above.
report.seeMoon: Emotional nature. See the reading above.
report.generational: Shared with everyone born within about {years} years.
report.mayBe: Possibly {sign}: it changed sign that day.
report.aspectsLead: The closest angles between planets, tightest first.
report.aspectsLeadNoMoon: The closest angles between planets, tightest first. The Moon is left out because it moves too fast to place without an hour.
report.compareLead: Set this chart beside another person in the family.
report.method: Method: Western tropical zodiac; geocentric apparent positions of date; whole-sign houses when hour and place are known; aspects by orb (conjunction and opposition 8°, trine and square 7°, sextile 5°). Dates are read in the Gregorian calendar. Before standard time zones, local mean time at the birthplace is used. Readings are interpretive templates, not research findings.

synastry.eyebrow: Synastry · two charts side by side
synastry.unavailable: Both people need a full birth date before their charts can be compared.
synastry.noMoonNotice: At least one birth hour is unknown, so that person’s Moon is left out of the comparison.
synastry.contactsLead: Angles between the planets of {a} and those of {b}, tightest first.
synastry.none: No close contacts between these charts.

admin.queueLead: Research happens offline. This desk is for receiving requests, adding the ancestors you find, and publishing your findings.
admin.queueEmpty: No requests have been submitted yet.
admin.peopleLead: Intake people, plus any ancestors you add. Each person with a full birth date gets a birth report automatically.
admin.publicationLead: Write in Markdown. Save a draft as often as you like; the requester sees nothing until you publish.
admin.publicationLive: These findings are live. Changes you save are visible to the requester and their invited readers immediately.

mk.metaTitle: Ancestor birth charts & family history by hand | Ascendant
mk.metaDescription: A genealogist researches your family line by hand in the archives. You receive the findings, a family tree, a map and a birth chart for every ancestor. Free during the first version.
mk.serviceName: Hand-researched family history with a birth chart for every ancestor
mk.ctaTitle: Whose sky would you like to read first?
mk.ctaBody: Tell us who you know. A person does the research, and you read what was found, with a birth chart for every ancestor.
mk.ctaNote: Free during the first version · private by default
mk.getTitle: A family history you can read, walk through and keep
mk.getLead: When the research is done, your findings are published privately for you and the relatives you invite.
mk.get1Title: A tree drawn as a sky
mk.get1Body: Every generation on its own orbit, each person marked with their Sun sign, with lines joining those born under the same one.
mk.get2Body: Where each ancestor was born, lived and died, and the path each one took between those places.
mk.get3Body: A written account of what was found and what is still open, with the book and page behind every claim.
mk.get4Title: A birth report for each ancestor
mk.get4Body: A natal chart and a written reading for everyone with a full birth date, and an honest note where the hour is unknown.
mk.getHow: How it works and what it costs
mk.teaserTitle: Start with your own chart. It takes one minute.
mk.teaserBody: Enter a birth date and see the Sun, the Moon and every planet by sign. Add the hour and the place for the rising sign. No account, nothing stored.
mk.teresaTitle: One person, reading the original records
mk.teresaBody: Every request is researched by me, by hand. I read the parish books, civil registers and censuses myself, I tell you where each fact comes from, and I tell you plainly when a record cannot be found. No software guesses on my behalf.
mk.guidesMetaTitle: Guides to family history and birth charts | Ascendant
mk.guidesLead: Short, practical reading on tracing a family and on reading the sky they were born under.
mk.newsBody: One short letter a month: what the sky is doing, and a new guide to tracing your family. Nothing else.
mk.newsConsent: I agree to receive this monthly email. I can unsubscribe at any time from a link in every message.
mk.newsDone: Thank you. You are on the list.
mk.newsError: Enter a valid email address and tick the box.
mk.chartMetaTitle: Free birth chart calculator, with or without birth time | Ascendant
mk.chartMetaDescription: Cast a free natal chart in a minute. See your Sun, Moon and rising sign and every planet, with a short reading. Works without a birth time. No account needed.
mk.chartLead: Enter a birth date to see the Sun, the Moon and every planet by sign, with a short reading. Add the hour and the place to find the rising sign. It works for you and for any ancestor.
mk.chartTimeHint: Leave it empty if you do not know it. Nothing will be guessed.
mk.chartErrorDate: Enter a full date of birth between the years 1600 and 2199.
mk.chartRisingMissing: The rising sign needs the hour and the place of birth. Add both above to see it.
mk.chartMoonEither: The Moon changed sign on this day. Add the hour of birth to know which of the two it is.
mk.chartNextTitle: Now imagine this for your great-grandmother
mk.chartNextBody: Ascendant researches your family line by hand and gives every ancestor a chart like this one, beside a tree, a map and the documents that prove it.
mk.chartWhy1Body: Most calculators assume midday when the hour is missing and show a rising sign that is not real. This one leaves out what cannot be known.
mk.chartWhy2Body: Dates back to the year 1600 are accepted, so you can cast a chart for a grandparent or for someone found in a parish book.
mk.chartWhy3Body: The birth details are used to draw the chart and are then discarded. Nothing is saved and no account is needed.
mk.sampleNote: This is what a finished request looks like. The family is invented for the example; yours would be researched by hand.
mk.sampleMetaTitle: Sample family history report with ancestor birth charts | Ascendant
mk.sampleMetaDescription: See a complete example: a family tree drawn as a star chart, a map of where each ancestor lived, written findings with sources and a birth report for every ancestor.
mk.privacyDraft: Draft. This text must be completed with the operator's legal details and reviewed by a lawyer before the site is launched.
mk.consentText: We would like to count visits and see which advertisements bring people here. Nothing is loaded unless you accept, and never on your private pages.
mk.unsubBody: Confirm and your address will be deleted from the list.
mk.unsubDone: Done. This address is not on the list.
